notes.title: Prison Boss Prohibition - Free Alpha Weekends on Quest & Launch Delay
notes.notes:
Hey fyolks! 🐔

[b]We’ve got a few important updates to share with you all[/b] — some exciting, some that require a bit of patience, but all part of the omelette AU fromage we’re cooking together.

[h3]👤 New Chief of Staff Appointed[/h3]
Please join us in giving a warm welcome to [b]our new Community Manager Ozan (schenkal on Discord)[/b], aka the Mayor’s right hand! 

They’ll be your go-to for all things community, events, and mischief. [b]Expect more activity, more transparency, and more F U N around here very soon.[/b]

[h3]🕒 Game Launch Delayed to Summer 2025[/h3]
Now, for the bad news. We know waiting is the hardest part — and we’re just as eager to get you fully immersed in illegal crafting shenanigans. 

To make sure everything hits the quality bar you deserve,[b] we’ve made the hard decision to shift our release to Summer 2025[/b]. It’s a tough call, a bad egg some might even say, but the right one. [b]We appreciate your love and support[/b] and can’t wait to show you what we’re cooking up.

[h3]🗺️ Alpha Roadmap Reveal[/h3]
BUT, we have some good news as well! [b]You won’t have to wait until Summer to play.[/b] Starting soon, we’re kicking off our [b]Free Alpha Playtest Weekends![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215978/25db933cd7d72d2ae9ef796c33467d0872bb2793.png[/img]

[u][b]Here’s how it’ll work:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Every 2 weeks, a new level will unlock and be [b]available to play all weekend long.[/b]
[*] Levels will rotate, giving everyone a chance to explore different environments and crafting themes. [*] It's currently only available on Quest, but we're doing our best to have a Steam version too before the end of the Alpha weekends. [/list]
This is your chance to help shape the game while having a blast. [b]We’ll be listening closely to your feedback every step of the way[/b] so please, feel free to share your thoughts!

[url=https://discord.gg/prisonboss][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215978/b749068f711b16929e0a72a381a974ac1c74effc.png[/img][/url]
As always, [url=https://discord.gg/prisonboss][b]JOIN US ON DISCORD[/b][/url], hit us up in the channels with your thoughts, questions, or wild theories. We love hearing from our favorite chickens. 🐔

[b]See you in New Yolk City, The Prison Boss team[/b]

[u][b]Don't forget to check out our Socials and have a chat with other Eggs![/b][/u]

notes.title: Prison Boss VR Minor Update - Ver. 1.5.11.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are making a small update to Prison Boss VR this week-end. The update should be live this Sunday, but you can access it right now if you go and select the Beta build in the Steam options of the game. Here is what this update fixes:

[list]
[*] Use of SteamVR for all headsets: this means[b] you can now play Prison Boss VR on Oculus Quest using Virtual Desktop[/b]! But also any other streaming or chat app that interacts with the SteamVR compositor will now work correctly! Furthermore, this means that if you don't like the way the buttons are setup, you will now be able to reconfigure the controller buttons using the SteamVR interface!

[*]You can now play Prison Boss VR while Steam is in offline mode: you will still need to play Prison Boss VR with Steam in online mode at least once per 30 days, but the rest of the time, you can play with Steam in offline mode!

[*] You can't move furniture at night anymore: a long time annoyance finally removed from the game!

[*] Better support for aggressive antivirus: we've had issues with some antivirus that impose very strict security rules, so we changed the location of saved games from the '.../Documents/My Games' folder to the '.../AppData/Roaming/ folder to avoid the extra security imposed on the documents folder. If you previously had issues with Prison Boss VR while your antivirus was running, and so had to mess with antivirus rules or turn it off, now you'll only have to play the game once like before and your save files will be transfered to that new folder. Afterwards you'll be able to play without avoir any security measures!

[*] We now use Unity Analytics to gather information: we used to use a different provider but moved to Unity now, this means that if you want to change if you share or not info with us, here is what you need to do: you go in the in-game options menu and click the analytics button, you'll be directed towards a web page that allows you to choose if you share or not data with us to improve support for the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Free Boss Mode update out now: New way to play, Comfort features, Medal system!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/4c4d327696c8f23be8aa35b39db117b38563f98f.png[/img]

Hey Prison Bosses!

Been a long time. We are proud to announce today our biggest update to Prison Boss VR, the Boss mode update, out now! This update took more time than expected to get out as we ported the game to PlayStation VR at the same time, which will also be out today in Americas and tomorrow in Europe. 

We’ve been working hard to offer you this new update, adding a brand new way to play the game!

If you read the forums, when we’re active (yes it happens sometimes… :) ), we’ve been talking about a sandbox mode. After months of designing, implementing and testing this new mode, we decided to give it a more unique name, thus the Boss mode.

[h1]What’s in the Boss Mode?![/h1]
Boss mode lets you decide your own strategy by giving you skill cards which you can use to unlock the items you desire. The goal is to make the highest score you can before the end of the serving time you go for. You can play for 20, 30 or 40 days in any of the 4 prisons. You can then continue your game if you wish but the score will be calculated at the end of the duration you chose.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/2d36687d96e5b8774be105fbc112f3a892da681e.gif[/img]

[h1]New comfort options, with the ability to play without room-scale[/h1]
This is one big new feature, especially for people who had not enough room to use room scale: You can now play seated with the new “distance interactions”. You can now “distance grab”, “distance drop” and rotate 90 degrees with a dedicated input.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/ef0462cbc21ec952f4f96adb6824ae2cdb047422.gif[/img]

[h1]New medals system for Story mode[/h1]
To make the Story mode more replayable, we added a medals system which lets you replay the prisons to perfect your score. The score is based on the total value of items sold, the number of jobs completed and the number of times you got caught by the guards during the playthrough. You then get a final medal related to your score! Go get those gold medals!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/a4b4f0050614b0cadf5d292373aa16cd2607a808.gif[/img]

[h1]Lots of fixes and small improvements[/h1]
Along with this, we fixed lots of performance and gameplay issues. We did lots of optimization, drastically reducing loading times and greatly improving overall framerate. You can read the full patch notes below.

[h1]New achievements[/h1]
Some new achievements have been added to offer some challenges related to the new mode and the medal system!

We hope you’ll like the new mode and the new comfort options for the people who had trouble with the standing experience before. It is available now for free! Ready. Set. Craft!

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Features:
	[list]
		[*]Brand new Boss mode
			[list]
				[*]Boss mode allows you to play the prison of your choice with the starter item of your choice, and later on unlock objects you want to craft
				[*]Boss mode becomes available after completing prison 2
			[/list]
		[*]Scores and medals based on gameplay performance for each prison completed
		[*]Full UI rework:
			[list]
				[*]Complete rework of the merchant for better user experience
				[*]All UI can be used from distance via a hand controlled pointer
				[*]More useful data on the progression tab (required XP to unlock new supplies, days passed, times caught and Items Sold value)
				[*]You can now get back the items you sold to the merchant if you cancel the trade instead of getting money
			[/list]
		[*]New comfort options (available in Options menu):
			[list]
				[*]Roomscale: same as before
				[*]Standing: self rotation button  
				[*]Sitting: distance interactions and self rotation button
			[/list]
			[*]New languages supported (Russian, Spanish and soon Traditional Chinese)
			[*]14 new achievements spread across the entire game
			[*]Can stream a filmed version of yourself playing Prison Boss VR with LIV (for Vive on Steam)
	[/list]
	
	[*]Improvements :
		[list]
			[*]Moderate performance increase
			[*]Loading and scene transition significantly faster
			[*]All prisons and a few objects have been prettied up a little bit
		[/list]
		
	[*]Bug fixes:
		[list]
			[*]Doesn’t play long intro when playing tutorials through the main menu anymore
			[*]Bobby can be sold only once per day
			[*]Tutorials screen now allows leaving back to Main Menu and will return thrown objects
			[*]Made very hard achievements more realistically obtainable
			[*]Improved issues caused by defective prisoner pathing
			[*]Fixed issues that could make announcers and merchants to not come
		[/list]
	[/list]

notes.title: Prison Boss VR On Sale All Week Long! Our New Upcoming Game Jousting Time Now On Kickstarter !
notes.notes:
Hey Prison Bosses!

We hope you are having a great time managing the supply of cake and teddy bears within the prison walls. We are taking this time to update you all about the developments at TREBUCHET and the future plans for Prison Boss.

[h1]Our New Game is Live on Kickstarter ![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/6ee835cb2f0c6048cda9ad48c9dc302b3f3bcc54.png[/img]

First of all, we are very proud to announce today TREBUCHET’s second VR game in the works: Jousting Time! We launched a Kickstarter campaign just now about this new exciting project that we have been working on since the end of 2017. Jousting Time was first created during a game jam in November and we decided to push this concept further with a unique way for VR players and non-VR players to interact. Have a look at the game on the Kickstarter page [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1602065925/jousting-time?ref=9649f3]right here![/url]

To celebrate this announcement, we give Prison Boss VR its largest sale discount on Steam ever![b] 40% off Prison Boss is on until next week![/b]

[h1]Now about Prison Boss![/h1]

The game recently won the “Mixed Reality” award from Microsoft’s Dream.Build.Play contest in March. Yaaaayyy! We were finalist with two other great VR games, Windlands and Racket: NX, so we were very proud of this unexpected recognition.

Since the launch, we did a lot of work on Prison Boss. The game was well polished with the Fall patches that enhanced the progression and added some furniture. We also worked on adding Windows MR and Oculus Rift Support and integrated language features allowing us to translate the game in French and Simplified Chinese. 

For the future of the game, we are looking into making a Playstation VR port. This port would allow us to add a simplified locomotion system to the Steam version of the game. We want players to be able to make the game work on Standing Mode instead of Roomscale only.

We are also working on doing a Prison Boss VR content patch for this summer. (Hopefully for the one year anniversary date of the game on August 29th.) We do not want to say much about this since nothing is final, but we want to increase the replayability of the game by adding a new game mode and online high score systems.

So yeah, this is about it! Do not hesitate to reach out if you have questions or comments! 

As a side note - Languages -

We are wondering which languages would be interesting and valuable for our player base? If you guys are really hoping for your native language to be added to the game, manifest your interest! If we have volunteers to translate the texts from the game we can do more language integrations that the ones we currently have!

Thanks everyone for playing Prison Boss VR and have a great day !

We launched a Kickstarter campaign just now about this new exciting project that we have been working on since the end of 2017. Jousting Time was first created during a game jam in November and we decided to push this concept further with a unique way for VR players and non-VR players to interact. Have a look at the game on the Kickstarter page [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1602065925/jousting-time?ref=9649f3]right here![/url]

To celebrate this announcement, we give Prison Boss VR its largest sale discount on Steam ever![b] 40% off Prison Boss is on until next week![/b]

[h1]Now about Prison Boss![/h1]

The game recently won the “Mixed Reality” award from Microsoft’s Dream.Build.Play contest in March. Yaaaayyy! We were finalist with two other great VR games, Windlands and Racket: NX, so we were very proud of this unexpected recognition.

Since the launch, we did a lot of work on Prison Boss. The game was well polished with the Fall patches that enhanced the progression and added some furniture. We also worked on adding Windows MR and Oculus Rift Support and integrated language features allowing us to translate the game in French and Simplified Chinese. 

For the future of the game, we are looking into making a Playstation VR port. This port would allow us to add a simplified locomotion system to the Steam version of the game. We want players to be able to make the game work on Standing Mode instead of Roomscale only.

We are also working on doing a Prison Boss VR content patch for this summer. (Hopefully for the one year anniversary date of the game on August 29th.) We do not want to say much about this since nothing is final, but we want to increase the replayability of the game by adding a new game mode and online high score systems.

So yeah, this is about it! Do not hesitate to reach out if you have questions or comments! 

As a side note - Languages -

We are wondering which languages would be interesting and valuable for our player base? If you guys are really hoping for your native language to be added to the game, manifest your interest! If we have volunteers to translate the texts from the game we can do more language integrations that the ones we currently have!

Thanks everyone for playing Prison Boss VR and have a great day !

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 - Posters !!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/25a689e54d087059468192b86d0ddf6cc3ff48bf.png[/img]

Hey Kingpins!

For the Steam Autumn Sale, we release this patch 1.1.1 which brings new decorations for your jail cell : Posters ! Inspired by famous movies, they will be a nice addition to your cell walls !

Along with this, we fixed numerous bugs and made improvements to the game following your feedback !

If you like Prison Boss VR, don't forget to vote for the game nomination for the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwardNominations/]Steam Awards[/url], we are sure that you'll find a fitting category !

Below you'll find detailed patch notes,

Thanks to everyone from the Trebuchet team !

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/37382a682de34b6970826ad08cd7f2c555990058.png[/img]

[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added movie posters in the Furniture Menu:
[*]Posters are selected at random when bought.
[*]Posters are rotated by moving the placement hand.
[*]More guidance was added to the game.
[*]A flying Bobby was added to guide players and help them noticing important game elements during their first days in prison 1.
[*]Added contextual arrows to help understand the first text tutorials.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous fixes and improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]On the first day, the dealer will not come once you read the tutorial texts from the announcer. The player can directly use the clock to skip to the night when ready to start.
[*]The video tutorials in the projector room now starts only when the player looks at the screen for the first time.
[*]Made the first hint texts of the game clearer by using better wording and more detailed animations.
[*]Made some texts appear more clearly by adding a background to them.
[*]Fixed a bug reported by a player regarding the dealer. He wasn’t hiding his hand when leaving and then wasn’t interacting with the player the next day.
[*]Fixed a bug reported by a player regarding the confiscated objects. Sometimes, the objects that were confiscated and then given back as a “first offence” were not interacting at all when used in crafting.
[*]Fixed some bugs that occurred on occasion and created instability in the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - Furniture Madness and Oculus Support
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/b81249cbf3928664502bb48efc4cbe16008eb03b.png[/img]

Hi Prison Bosses,

We have some pretty exciting stuff for you! Today is the release of patch 1.1.0. In this patch, you will have access to exciting new content as well as some bug fixes to make the experience of becoming a prison kingpin better.
 
First, we have added 6 new pieces of furniture and a progressive Arcade Mode. You will discover these as you progress through the game. As for the Arcade Mode, while until now it was unlocked after completing the whole game, it will now be unlocked after completing the first prison. As the players unlock new items to craft and pieces of furniture, they will be added to the Arcade Mode.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/33d5bfff8ea5277e678359bda87768a8ee044491.png[/img]
 
Second, the biggest change added to the game will be the new morning search features, where each morning the guards will search the players’ cells. Many players noted that the game was a bit too easy since they only had to skip to day when a guard was approaching, therefore avoiding any searches. By including morning search, the players will need to be savvier and think of how to organize the things they craft and the furniture within their cells.
 
Third, prison 1 has been rebalanced by adjusting the objectives and rewards, and by reducing the numbers of tiers needed to complete the prison. It is important to note that any game saved before the patch notes are released will be preserved.
 
Finally, in response to players’ feedback, a new tutorial system will be implemented, which will allow players to learn how to craft items as they encounter them in the game. This will make the learning experience more natural and progressive. New players will also be able to jump into gameplay faster.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/0086f6268da3a22a2f2220f40618a1818e6ab1de.png[/img]

And at last, we are also launching the game on Oculus Rift! We have tested the game with three sensors that allows players to replicate the playing experience of the Vive. 

So, have fun and most of all, try not to drop your bobbys!

[b]EDIT : To Oculus users who encountered an issue saying that they need to check their internet connection, this has been resolved in an update at 9:10PM EST. If you don't get the update, try to restart Steam. Thank you for your understanding![/b]

Here is the list of things we changed with patch 1.1 :

Main features
[list]
[*]New tutorial system
[*]Tutorial now happen when unlocking new crafts.
[*]Tutorial can be replayed from a new dedicated Tutorial Room.
[*]Prisons rebalancing
[*]Prison 1 balanced, and shrinked to 3 tiers. Start a new game to play with new balancing.
[*]New morning search feature
[*]Guard now search cell every morning.
[*]New furniture
[*]6 new pieces of furniture added
[*]Progressive Arcade Mode
[*]Arcade Mode now unlocks after finishing the first jail.
[*]Materials offered according to crafts unlocked in story mode.
[/list]

Oculus Support
[list]
[*]Full Oculus Touch support
[*]Oculus room-scale with 3 sensors
[/list]

Miscellaneous fixes and improvements
[list]
[*]Clock moved to the front of the cell
[*]Save files and progression adapted to new prison 1 balancing
[*]Dealer comes faster at the start of the day
[*]Various sound effects improvements
[*]Added credits when game ends.
[*]Improved Tap and Bottle colliders
[*]Enhanced text display in announcers
[*]Some guards now whistle or cough
[*]Save file informations are now more detailed in the main menu environment 
[*]Menu items like the save files and stamp now come back if launched away.
[/list]

    [*]Fixed all the furniture joints. Both drawers and doors should behave as intended.
    [*]Fixed job issues in the fourth prison
    [*]Fixed an achievement mix-up with the last jobs of the fourth prison
    [*]Fixed some issues with the containers

Cheers!

Vincent from Trebuchet

notes.title: Prison Boss VR Release
notes.notes:
We are really excited to announce the release of Prison Boss VR! It’s only the beginning, we consider the game as a full release but we are already thinking about a set of free updates that will be made in the coming months :

[list]
[*]Oculus Rift support. Implement native support for Oculus.
[*]More furniture and customization options for the cell. We want to allow players to make each game unique and fuel the diversity of tactics through more furniture options.
[*]New Sandbox Mode. This free play mode would allow players to have all the possible crafting options to unlock in the same game and try to compete for a more long-term high score than the Arcade Mode.
[*]Localization.
[/list]

[b]Note for Oculus owners[/b]
As is, the game seems to work. However, we did not have the opportunity to properly test it and adapt it, so please tell us about your issues if you have some, it will help us make the port.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30371924/ee7b5fec28e89dbafc7879d55659dc51c1e16925.png[/img]

We’ll listen to every feedback you will come up with and you can use the discussions in the community to do so or email us at support@trebuchet.fun

We hope you will have a great time playing Prison Boss and share your experience if you like the game!

- Vincent, Guillaume and Alexandre from Trebuchet
